scope: Bounded discovery of adopted GA81 instruments potentially relevant to UN80 and peace-operations administrative or budgetary efficiency; not a complete session legal digest.

search_receipt.method: Official-domain web search, direct library retrieval and its linked embedded table; attempted official Fifth Committee, GA81 proposal portal and resolution resolver retrieval.
query_families: site:un.org eighty-first session mandate implementation review resolution
search_receipt.authentication_limit: Search service rendering and official index provenance only; no retained final adopted-text bytes, complete voting-record export or complete decisions register.

interpretation_limits: No in-scope GA81 reform obligation is verified by this bounded review. This is not a claim that none exists.
The five rows are the retrieved table population, not a certification of the full session population or an enumeration of all decisions.
A/81/6 proposals and A/81/7 ACABQ advice remain distinct from A/RES/81 adopted resolutions.
Session 81 is ongoing; later instruments and unindexed documents can change the baseline.
Unknown authority is not evidence of noncompliance, implementation failure or waste.
